Ligand 1 is the central-methyl variant at 0.44 and atom 0 is its pyridine 4-methyl, acyclic bond to atom 1. The pyridine ring scan was the most informative thing I did - it showed C4 productive, C5 harmful, C3 and C6 fatal - and the central ring is now clearly where the remaining gains are, since moving the anilide to meta was worth +0.09 and a methyl on that ring worth +0.03. So I will scan the central ring the same systematic way. With the arylamine at C1 and the anilide meta to it at C3, the open positions are C2 between the two nitrogens, C4 ortho to the anilide, C5 meta to both, and C6 ortho to the arylamine. This episode takes C5 - the one position that is meta to both donors and therefore the least likely to interfere with either, which makes it the cleanest test of whether the ring simply wants more bulk anywhere or wants it at a specific contact. Everything else stays at its best measured setting. Expected product: about 281 Da.
